Vande Bharat Express Achieves 100 kmph Speed on Chenab and Anji Bridges

The Vande Bharat Express has successfully completed a trial run at 100 kmph across the Chenab Bridge and the Anji Khad Bridge in Jammu and Kashmir. Railway Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw announced this achievement, noting it as a new record for the train. The Chenab Bridge is recognized as the world's highest railway bridge, and the Anji Khad Bridge is India's first cable-stayed railway bridge. This trial signifies a milestone for the Katra-Banihal section.
